observedDefect: Existing once driver proves owner API invocation but discards its opaque rejection; no qualified existing independent audit route was found. Source improvement cannot diagnose that historical failure.

diagnosticContract.carrier: Nonenumerable immutable safeP1Hold data on a fixed-message Error with no stack/cause; consume only checked metadata, never serialize an Error.
diagnosticContract.stageMeaning: Entered local source stage only; primary failure separate from first cleanup failure. Child/ACK/exit never proves SSH exec, auth or target work.
diagnosticContract.stderrBytesObservedMeaning: Bounded bytes observed, possibly partial; cancellation without observed bytes remains UNREAD/null. No stderr text/hash retained.
diagnosticContract.cleanupMeaning: CONFIRMED means that local resource step completed; NOT_REACHED or UNKNOWN remains explicit. No native/remote cleanup claim.
diagnosticContract.sourcePinsMeaning: Hash-shaped declarations from explicit expected input, not proof that source qualification succeeded.
diagnosticContract.unknownLegacyFailure: A caller projection must return explicit UNKNOWN for untagged, malformed or accessor-based errors.

taskBindingMeaning: Existing canonical Task only. Operational step label is not a GitTask/native ID; no duplicate Task registration.

readerCleanupReviewClosure.change: Inspect cancellation settlement status only. Any rejection or lock-release error leaves readers UNKNOWN and first cleanup hold readers; await read settlement, attempt every lock release, then continue permitted FD cleanup. A primary read rejection alone is not a cleanup failure.
